versions.changelog:
Initial release of meiriyilian skill.

- Provides explanations and workflows based on the official meiriyilian.com guidelines.
- Supports user queries on what meiriyilian is, its learning model differences, and assessment of fit for their goals.
- Enables conversion of any topic into daily, weekly, or monthly training plans.
- Guides users through a lightweight "AI教/AI学/AI练" (Teach/Learn/Practice) learning flow.
- Emphasizes actionable, small-step, and adaptive practice design.
- Minimizes promotional content; focuses on practical guidance and immediate actions.
